title: Chain events — 2026-11-16
body: **Nvidia Q3 FY27 — Tue Nov 17, after US close (CFO commentary ~16:20 ET / 22:20 CET; call 17:00 ET / 23:00 CET).** Consensus per LSEG/Visible Alpha: revenue ~$109B (+~90% YoY; company guide $108B ±2%), adj. EPS ~$2.47, data-center ~$101.8B, gross margin ~74%, Q4 guide ~$125B. This is the first print since CEO Jensen Huang's resignation (Nov 12); options imply an ~8–9% move. Read-through by sleeve: semis (TSM, ASML, MU, AVGO) take the direct demand signal; infrastructure (VRT, ETN, ANET, DLR) hinges on Q4 capex commentary; power/utilities (CEG, VST, GEV, TLN) need confirmation of datacenter load growth; the ~15% cash sleeve is the buffer if guidance disappoints. Macro: Warsh speaks today (time unverified); FOMC minutes Wed.
